title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance Operations
text:
Location: On-site – Alachua, Florida (Greater Gainesville Metropolitan Area) 
Department: Quality Assurance 
Reports To: Head of Global Quality 
Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site

### **About Ascend Advanced Therapies**

Ascend Advanced Therapies is a biotechnology company specializing in the development and manufacturing of advanced therapies, with a focus on adeno-associated virus (AAV) gene therapies. Our team is committed to advancing innovative treatments through scientific expertise, operational excellence, and a strong culture of quality and compliance.

#### **About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Quality Assurance Operations to join our team at our Alachua, Florida facility.

In this leadership role, you will oversee Quality Assurance activities supporting GMP manufacturing, Quality Control, warehouse, facilities, and related operations. You will provide strategic oversight of quality processes, ensure regulatory compliance and inspection readiness, and drive continuous improvement across site operations.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive Quality Assurance experience in a regulated manufacturing environment, demonstrated people leadership capabilities, and strong knowledge of GMP requirements, investigations, CAPAs, change control, and quality risk management.

This is a full-time, on-site leadership opportunity for an experienced quality professional who is passionate about developing high-performing teams, strengthening operational excellence, and supporting the advancement of innovative therapies.

#### **Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Lead Quality Assurance support for GMP manufacturing, Quality Control, warehouse, facilities, and support operations.
* Establish departmental priorities and ensure quality activities support production schedules, client commitments, and regulatory requirements.
* Promote a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.
* Provide strategic oversight of batch record review, room release, on-floor QA activities, manufacturing investigations, and product disposition support.
* Ensure appropriate QA oversight of Quality Control operations, including analytical data review, laboratory investigations, Environmental Monitoring, and data integrity compliance.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for significant manufacturing and laboratory compliance issues.
* Oversee investigations, deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, and quality risk management activities.
* Monitor quality metrics and compliance trends to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure inspection readiness through effective management of quality systems and compliance programs.
* Lead Quality participation during regulatory inspections, client audits, and corporate audits.
* Serve as the primary Quality representative during client interactions and compliance-related discussions.
* Review and approve responses to audit observations and regulatory commitments.
* Directly supervise and develop Quality Assurance personnel, including Senior Quality Operations Specialists.
* Establish performance objectives, provide coaching, and support employee development.
* Build team capability through mentoring, training, and succession planning.
* Provide independent, risk-based quality leadership across site operations.
* Balance business objectives with regulatory compliance requirements.
* Drive resolution of complex quality and compliance challenges.
* Influence cross-functional decision-making through technical expertise and sound judgment.
* Escalate significant compliance risks to senior leadership as appropriate.

#### **Educational Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering, Pharmacy, or related scientific discipline.
* Minimum 8-10 years of Quality Assurance experience within biologics, cell therapy, gene therapy, vaccine, or pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Minimum 3 years of progressive people leadership and supervisory experience, including performance management, employee development, talent management, succession planning, and employee engagement.
* Demonstrated experience supporting GMP manufacturing and Quality Control operations.
* Experience managing investigations, CAPAs, Change Controls, and quality risk assessments.
* Experience participating in or hosting FDA, client, and regulatory inspections.
* Strong technical knowledge of:

* + 21 CFR Parts 210, 211, 600, and 610
 + EU GMP Volume 4
 + Annex 1
 + ICH Q7, Q9, and Q10
 + FDA Data Integrity Guidance
 + FDA Process Validation Guidance
* Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects/tasks at one time, as well as management of program interdependencies to meet set timelines.

Preferred:

* Commercial biologics manufacturing experience.
* CDMO experience supporting multiple client programs.
* Experience supporting technology transfer and process validation activities.
* ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or equivalent certification.
* Experience utilizing electronic Quality Management Systems (MasterControl, Veeva, TrackWise, or equivalent).

#### **Physical Requirements**

This position requires the ability to perform duties in a combination of office and GMP-regulated manufacturing environments. Physical activities may include prolonged sitting or standing, walking throughout manufacturing and laboratory areas, reaching, bending, and performing repetitive motions associated with computer work and documentation review.

The role requires manual dexterity for typing and handling documents and materials, as well as visual acuity sufficient to review records, analyze data, read equipment labels, and distinguish colors.

Occasional lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling of materials may be required as appropriate to the position.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

#### **Travel Requirements**

Approximately 10%.

#### **Supervisory Responsibilities**

This position has direct supervisory responsibilities for Quality Assurance personnel, including performance management, coaching, employee development, and succession planning.

A minimum of three years of progressive people leadership and supervisory experience is required.
